text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since the Takarazuka Kinen.
...I told Cheval Grand to take today off as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, simply letting her body rest won't
be enough to ease her anxieties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If only there were something
that could rouse Cheval Grand's frightened heart—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh— Whoosh—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What in the world am I doing...
Not even training, just hanging around here...)

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: ...Found you, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Shine...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm here! I heard from
Trainer that you're resting right now?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, since we're already here,
why don't we walk together for a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to hear a lot
of stories from you, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
To be expected of, to be acknowledged—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: And then, you became afraid of letting people down. You didn't want to disappoint them, so you started rushing, thinking you had to do better.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I really look like an idiot, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I stopped so many times, going in circles in the same place.
Just when I thought I was finally moving forward, that I was finally stronger...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I just can't keep staying strong.
Seriously... why am I always like this...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: If it's her...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If it were a "great Umamusume,"
I'm sure they wouldn't think like this...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“Now, the Arima Kinen heads into its final stage!
Can anyone defeat this shockingly powerful,
undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume—?!”

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A leap-like stride approaches rapidly from the outside!
Passing the 200m mark,
will she pull alongside, will she―― Oh, look at that!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And they won't reach her! She crosses the line!!
A run of pure tenacity hands the undefeated 'Hero' her first defeat, seizing a magnificent maiden GⅠ victory—!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Yellow Racing Silk
text_block_list.text: "—Aaaaaaaagh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If it were her, I'm sure...
she'd shoulder those expectations with head held high.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I can't even do that, then I...
have no right to become a "great horse girl"—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cheval-chan.
May I ask you something?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Wh-What?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Why do you look up to that Umamusume so much?

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...Was it because
I really stood out in a big race?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I don't know.
I don't think it's anything like that...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: So, is it because she won against super strong opponents? Like, Cheval-chan wants to mow down tough rivals just like that too?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"No, no!
I-It's not anything like that..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Back then... in the junior club I went to with my older sisters, I was the only one... Nobody expected anything from me at all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Back when I felt like I had nowhere I belonged... I happened to watch that race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"A leap-like stride approaches rapidly from the outside!
Passing the 200m mark,
will she pull alongside, will she―― Oh, look at that!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And they won't reach her! She crosses the line!!
A run of pure tenacity hands the undefeated 'Hero' her first defeat, seizing a magnificent maiden GⅠ victory—!!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in Yellow Racing Silk
text_block_list.text: "—Aaaaaaaagh!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Before the race... almost nobody
thought that person was going to win.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, on the final uphill climb...
As the "Hero" accelerated from the rear, threatening to devour every Umamusume in the pack...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: She took the lead—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was cheering for the "Hero."
Everyone truly believed that the "Hero" would overtake them.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even so, she held on, and on, keeping her back firmly in their sights right to the very end—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"The moment she won, she roared up at the sky!
...In that moment, I'm sure I heard it."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ‘Show 'em what you've got!’ ...she said—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Even if I'm weak, even if I lack confidence—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Anyone is allowed to seek a place in the sun.
Anyone is allowed to dream of being someone great.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That it's okay to scream recklessly, desperately,
about what you want and who you want to be...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...She gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because you showed me that I should fight for my place and give it my all.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I was able to make the decision to change clubs...
I got to meet you, Shine...
and I was able to come to Tracen Academy like this.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's why... yeah. That's why I...
longed to become a "great Uma Musume."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
So that I can give courage to someone...
like a coward like me, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: That she wanted to become a "great Umamusume" like that.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Then to me, my
'great Umamusume' is you, Cheval-chan.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Because they gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Cheval-chan.
This summer, I—"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I'm leaving Tracen Academy in August.
...I'm transferring to Australia.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Hu...... huh?
A-Australia...?!

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
...To be honest, you know.
I was wondering what I should do.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I talked a big game around the start of the year and before the Hanshin Daishoten, but...
in truth, my race record has been pretty mediocre the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
I somehow managed to reach a graded race, but...
I feel like that might be my limit.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: A dream like “standing in the center of applause that reaches the sky”... I had started to think that maybe it was just beyond my reach after all.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
But you know...
...Because you kept challenging yourself.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Even when terrified, feeling weak, or in pain.
Even so, never stopping your advance,
rising again and again, growing stronger—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out toward a dream.
Because you were there doing just that.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want to take on the challenge too.
...It made me realize I still want to keep trying."

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
In this new land, I will take on new races.
I'll search for ways to become stronger that I couldn't do here.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text: Because, deep down, I want to make my dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Because you gave me...
the courage to make it come true.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Shine—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (In the end... I'm still just a coward.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Timid. Full of anxiety. Lacking confidence.
An Umamusume who doesn't suit the word
..."great" in the slightest.)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...Even so...!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer, um...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Could we please resume
our training starting tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Night. Visiting the Trainer's Room, she stated it
with a clear, steady voice.
...A resolute light shone in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um... I'm sorry for stopping in my tracks like that. But—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to stay standing still.
I... I want to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Toward my dream.
...Even if it's just one step at a time.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yes... I really do want to become stronger.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's not because I'm scared.
And it's not because I don't want to disappoint them...
Well, I mean, that's a little bit of it, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“N-No, that's not what I mean.
...Even someone like me.”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Because I have a dream I want to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even I could. ...No, precisely because it's me, I can make it come true.
...Because you've given me courage once again—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I stand up and take out the prepared documents.
The truth is, I've been preparing them all along.
Ever since the Takarazuka Kinen ended.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I knew that right now, she should be resting, that she should be made to stop.
And yet, just as strongly—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times she faced her own weakness,
she never stopped moving forward. I believed that she would
surely rise to the occasion once more.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Yes!!
I look forward to working with you...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with her back on her feet,
we set our next sights on the post-summer graded race,
the Kyoto Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For her path through medium and long distances, this is a fitting first race back after summer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, let's aim for that and train hard—
Cheval Grand and I reaffirmed our vow once more.
